name: Bread Warmer
snippet: Add a little extra pizzazz to your table with this bread warmer
story: A bread warmer is a cozy little assistant when you want to keep those tortillas, buns, slices of homemade bread warm on the table.  Just heat it in your oven at 350 degrees or less for around 10  minutes, place it in your basket with a nice napkin or dish towel and impress your guests with warm bread!
